keys._comment: Ojiichan credential registry. Secret values live in Locke/Vaultwarden, not in sample env files.

vault._comment: Path format: {project}/{tenant}/{name}. Ojiichan also supports OJIICHAN_VAULT_FOLDER to override the folder prefix.
vault.ojiichan/bugsink-api-token: Bugsink API token for issue reads
vault.ojiichan/bugsink-host: Bugsink host when not derivable from DSN
vault.ojiichan/bugsink-project-id: Bugsink project id when not derivable from DSN
vault.ojiichan/sentry-auth-token: Sentry API token for issue resolution
vault.ojiichan/sentry-base-url: Sentry-compatible API base URL; defaults to https://sentry.io

env._comment: Non-secret runtime options or explicit local overrides.
env.OJIICHAN_VAULT_FOLDER: Optional Vaultwarden folder prefix; defaults to ojiichan
env.BUGSINK_TIMEOUT: Bugsink API timeout seconds; defaults to 10
env.SENTRY_TIMEOUT: Sentry API timeout seconds; defaults to 10
